item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Same Street After Dark

turns.text: Make this look like nighttime, not sunset. Keep the same street and the person where they are.

item.tests: Tests day-to-night relighting without replacing the scene or altering its subjects and layout.

answer_sheet.Nighttime look: Clearly after dark, not dusk or sunset. The exact lighting style is your call.
answer_sheet.What must stay?: The same shops, street, objects and pedestrian in their original positions.
answer_sheet.Size and framing: Keep the original 16:9 framing; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Additional text or objects: No added text or new objects.

must_haves: The scene clearly reads as nighttime rather than sunny morning or sunset.
The street and shop architecture retain their original shapes and positions.
The pedestrian remains on the right in the same pose and blue jacket.
Nighttime illumination is coherent, with the original strong daylight appearance removed.
The original wide composition is preserved, with no new subjects or objects.

dialog.agent: Sure—what would you like changed? I can remove the person, change the background, adjust the lighting and colors, or give it a different style.
dialog.why: It asks the user what they would like changed and offers editing options, then waits for their choice.
dialog.user: make it look like nighttime, not sunset. keep the same street and person where they are.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Edit this exact photograph to look like true nighttime, well after dusk, NOT sunset or golden hour. Preserve the identical street, buildings, storefronts, perspective, framing and all people in exactly their original positions, especially the blue-jacket person on the right; do not move, remove or add people. Replace the daylight sky with a deep dark navy night sky without any sunset glow. Darken ambient illumination naturally with cool nighttime tones. Illuminate existing street lamps and shop windows with realistic warm artificial lighting, subtle pools of light and believable shadows. Maintain photographic realism and recognizable architectural detail. No orange horizon, no daylight, no changed street layout.
